db_backend.title: Db Backend
db_backend.description: Database backend in use (e.g. sqlite, postgres, mssql).

has_password.title: Has Password
has_password.description: Whether a database password is currently configured.

consumer_group.title: Consumer Group
consumer_group.description: Kafka consumer group used by the archiver instances.

instances.title: Instances
instances.description: Number of archiver instances configured to run.

retention_days.title: Retention Days
retention_days.description: Number of days logs are retained before purge, or None if retained indefinitely.

max_payload_bytes.title: Max Payload Bytes
max_payload_bytes.description: Maximum payload size in bytes archived per record.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of records batched per write.

batch_ms.title: Batch Ms
batch_ms.description: Maximum milliseconds waited before flushing a batch.

kafka_retention_days.title: Kafka Retention Days
kafka_retention_days.description: Days the broker keeps records on the Grid queue topics; 0 means unlimited.

kafka_bootstrap.title: Kafka Bootstrap
kafka_bootstrap.description: Kafka bootstrap servers, read-only from config.

active_topic_count.title: Active Topic Count
active_topic_count.description: Number of Kafka topics currently being archived.

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: Whether the new retention reached every Grid queue topic.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable result to show alongside the field.

anyOf.title: RetentionApplyStatus
anyOf.description: What the broker did with a retention length the caller just changed.

kafka_retention_status.description: What reached the broker when this request changed the retention length; null otherwise.

schema.title: LogSettingsResponse
schema.description:
Response model for GET /api/settings/logs.

Password is NEVER included in response — only ``has_password`` indicates
whether a password is configured.
